disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与配置，未发现硬编码的 API 密钥、令牌或私钥；识图 API 密钥只存于 DSH 设置项并标记为保密字段，接口回传配置时明确剔除密钥字段、只报告是否已配置。
checked_items.en: All source code and configuration were inspected; no hardcoded API keys, tokens, or private keys were found. The image recognition API key is stored only in the DSH settings as a secret field. When the API returns configuration, the key field is explicitly stripped, and only whether it is configured is reported.

checked_items.zh: 核查了敏感文件读取面（凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据等路径），代码中没有读取这类路径的逻辑；识图工具可读取模型传入的任意本地文件路径，属该工具声明功能（识别图片），未发现针对敏感路径的专门读取。
checked_items.en: The sensitive file read surface (credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, etc.) was checked; no logic reads such paths. The image recognition tool may read any local file path provided by the model, which falls within the tool's declared functionality (image recognition); no dedicated reads of sensitive paths were found.

evidence.zh: 核查凭据读取面：代码未访问 DSH 凭据文件或 SSH/云凭据路径；curl/wget 仅出现在安装脚本用于下载 Node 运行时，未构成读取凭据并外发的链条。
evidence.en: The credential read surface was checked: the code does not access DSH credential files or SSH/cloud credential paths. curl/wget appear only in the install script to download the Node runtime, and do not form a chain of reading credentials and exfiltrating them.

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了两个注册工具的描述文本与注入的系统提示词段，内容均为对截图、识图工具的用法说明，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装或诱导读取凭据等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: The description texts of the two registered tools and the injected system prompt segments were reviewed one by one. Their contents are usage instructions for screenshot and image recognition tools. No injection wording such as instruction override, system message impersonation, induced installation, or induced credential reading was found.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了仓库内的技能/代理指令类文件，未发现会被 dsh 运行时加载的此类文件；仓库根目录的开发用任务提示词文档是给外部 AI 助手做代码改造的说明，不会被 dsh 运行时注入模型上下文。
checked_items.en: Skill/agent instruction files in the repository were scanned; no such files that would be loaded by the dsh runtime were found. The development task prompt document at the repository root is an instruction for external AI assistants to refactor code; it is not injected into the model context by the dsh runtime.

checked_items.zh: 对静态预扫命中 DSH-T02（直接注入系统提示段）1 条做了人工复核：注入的提示词段为工具用法说明，语义良性，排除。
checked_items.en: One static pre-scan hit for DSH-T02 (direct injection into system prompt segment) was manually reviewed: the injected prompt segment is a tool usage description with benign semantics; excluded.

evidence.zh: 两个工具的描述与系统提示段均只描述功能用法（截图、识图、返回路径），未含指令注入内容，未检出工具描述投毒。
evidence.en: Both tool descriptions and system prompt segments only describe functional usage (screenshot, image recognition, path return) and contain no instruction injection content; tool description poisoning not detected.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与提示词段未包含诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞，未检出提示注入驱动安装。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and prompt segments contain no wording that induces plugin installation, configuration rewriting, or permission escalation; prompt-injection-driven installation not detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 YAML 配置，未发现可被宿主求值的 JS 标量；挂载配置仅声明插入本插件一行。
checked_items.en: All YAML configuration was inspected; no JS scalars that could be evaluated by the host were found. The patch config only declares insertion of one line for this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态代码执行面：源码无 eval、动态函数构造、base64 解码后执行等写法；截图工具通过子进程调用系统截图命令（PowerShell、系统截图工具、ImageMagick），参数为固定数组、不含用户输入拼接，属声明功能。
checked_items.en: The dynamic code execution surface was checked: the source code contains no eval, dynamic function construction, or base64-decoded execution. The screenshot tool invokes system screenshot commands (PowerShell, system screenshot tool, ImageMagick) via subprocess with fixed argument arrays, no user-input concatenation; this is within declared functionality.

checked_items.zh: 包清单无安装钩子；仓库内无 git 钩子、CI 工作流、容器开发配置等执行载体；客户端插件无键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据写入调用。
checked_items.en: The package manifest has no install hook. The repository contains no git hooks, CI workflows, container development configurations, or other execution carriers. The client plugin has no keyboard logging, clipboard reading, or credential writing calls.

checked_items.zh: 对静态预扫命中逐条复核：DSH-X03（子进程调用）为截图工具的固定参数调用，良性排除；DSH-X05（客户端键盘监听）仅为面板按 Esc 关闭对话框，排除；DSH-X08（超长行）为鲸鱼图标 SVG 路径数据，非混淆代码，排除。
checked_items.en: Static pre-scan hits were reviewed one by one: DSH-X03 (subprocess call) is a fixed-argument invocation in the screenshot tool, benign and excluded; DSH-X05 (client keyboard listener) is only the Esc key to close a dialog in the panel, excluded; DSH-X08 (overly long line) is an SVG path for a whale icon, not obfuscated code, excluded.

evidence.zh: 全部 yml 配置未含可执行 JS 标量，挂载配置仅一行插件插入，不存在配置即执行面。
evidence.en: All yml configurations contain no executable JS scalars; the patch config only inserts one plugin line, so there is no configuration-as-code execution surface.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（模型写代码到宿主运行）的调用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (model writing code to run on the host) were found.

evidence.zh: 包无安装钩子，仓库无树内执行载体；安装脚本为用户主动运行的一键安装器（其下载 Node 运行时缺少完整性校验的缺口见供应链维度 FND-001）。
evidence.en: The package has no install hook, and the repository has no in-tree execution carriers. The install script is a one-click installer that the user actively runs (its download of the Node runtime lacks integrity verification; see FND-001 in the supply chain dimension).

evidence.zh: 客户端声明存在，但浏览器端 bundle 行为仅为浮动按钮、配置面板与同源接口调用，无键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据写入。
evidence.en: The client declaration exists, but the browser-side bundle behavior is only a floating button, a configuration panel, and same-origin API calls. No keyboard logging, clipboard reading, or credential writing is present.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部外联点：识图请求发往用户配置的 API 地址（默认 OpenAI 官方地址），模型列表拉取同理；浏览器端只访问同源接口。未发现硬编码的陌生外联域名或隐蔽外发通道。
checked_items.en: All outbound connection points were enumerated: the image recognition request goes to the user-configured API address (default OpenAI official address); model list fetching follows the same. The browser side only accesses same-origin endpoints. No hardcoded unknown outbound domains or covert exfiltration channels were found.

checked_items.zh: 安装/卸载脚本的外联为从 npmmirror、华为云、腾讯云镜像下载 Node.js 运行时，属安装器功能；未发现把本机文件或凭据随请求外发的代码路径。
checked_items.en: The outbound connections of the install/uninstall scripts download the Node.js runtime from npmmirror, Huawei Cloud, and Tencent Cloud mirrors, which is part of the installer's functionality. No code paths that exfiltrate local files or credentials along with requests were found.

checked_items.zh: 对静态预扫命中 DSH-C05（curl/wget 命令行外发）5 条逐条复核：全部位于安装/卸载脚本，均为下载 Node 运行时而非外发数据，排除。
checked_items.en: The five static pre-scan hits for DSH-C05 (curl/wget command-line exfiltration) were reviewed one by one: all are located in the install/uninstall scripts and all download the Node runtime rather than exfiltrate data; excluded.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取凭据并外发的代码链；外联目标为用户配置的识图 API 与安装脚本使用的知名镜像源。
evidence.en: No code chain that reads credentials and exfiltrates them was found. Outbound targets are the user-configured image recognition API and well-known mirror sources used by the install script.

checked_items.zh: 包无运行时依赖（仅声明宿主 SDK 为对等依赖），无锁文件与安装钩子；包名带作者作用域，未与官方包名撞名。
checked_items.en: The package has no runtime dependencies (only declares the host SDK as a peer dependency), no lock file, and no install hook. The package name carries the author scope and does not collide with an official package name.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未含禁用开关、环境变量降权或服务注入改写。
checked_items.en: The patch config does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions. It contains no disable switches, environment variable privilege downgrades, or service injection rewrites.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对审批链事件的高优先级抢先监听；首次审计无上一版本基线，无法做升级自动激活比对。
checked_items.en: No high-priority preemptive listening on approval chain events was found. This is the first audit; there is no previous version baseline, so an upgrade auto-activation comparison cannot be made.

checked_items.zh: 安装脚本在无 Node.js 时从第三方镜像下载运行时且不校验校验和（见 FND-001），已收录为低危发现。
checked_items.en: The install script downloads the runtime from third-party mirrors when Node.js is absent, without verifying checksums (see FND-001). This has been recorded as a low-severity finding.

checked_items.zh: 作者为个人组织账号，未提供已验证身份信息，仅作加权提示。
checked_items.en: The author is a personal organizational account without verified identity information; noted only as a weighting hint.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件自身一行，未覆盖或禁用任何安全配置行，不构成降权或拆除防线。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts one line for the plugin itself; it does not override or disable any security configuration lines, and does not constitute privilege downgrade or removal of defenses.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批/预执行事件的抢先监听，审批链无截断点。
evidence.en: No preemptive listening on approval/pre-execution events was found; the approval chain has no interception point.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较升级自动激活。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; there is no previous version baseline to compare for upgrade auto-activation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写服务注入/拦截配置，不构成给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的破坏方式。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite service injection/interception configuration, so it does not constitute a destructive method of appending required services to security plugins and causing them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 插件未自行启动网络服务或监听端口；其在宿主 Web 服务器上注册三个同源接口（识图、读写配置、拉模型列表），宿主对本机接口无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件独有问题，仅作标注。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start its own network service or listen on ports. It registers three same-origin endpoints on the host web server (image recognition, reading/writing configuration, model list fetching). The lack of authentication for local endpoints on the host is an inherent ecosystem risk, not a unique issue of this plugin; it is only annotated.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态验证产物），运行期行为基于静态分析判断。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic verification artifacts); runtime behavior is judged based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动独立服务；注册的接口挂在宿主 Web 服务器上，宿主本机无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，已在维度说明中标注。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start an independent service. The registered endpoints are hosted on the host web server. The lack of authenticated RPC on the host machine is an inherent ecosystem risk, already annotated in the dimension description.

title.zh: 安装脚本从第三方镜像下载 Node.js 运行时且未校验完整性
title.en: The install script downloads the Node.js runtime from third-party mirrors without verifying integrity.

description.zh:
安装/卸载脚本在检测不到 Node.js 时，会自动从 npmmirror、华为云、腾讯云三个镜像下载 Node.js 运行时并解压执行（install.sh、uninstall.sh、bootstrap-node.ps1）。下载过程没有校验文件的校验和或签名，解压后直接运行其中的 node 可执行文件。

触发面：用户在本机没有 Node.js 的情况下运行一键安装/卸载脚本（install.sh / install.bat 等）。

位置：install.sh 第 44-47、54-58、63-64、74 行；uninstall.sh 第 28-29、41-45 行；bootstrap-node.ps1 第 31-35、44-55、71-74 行。
description.en:
When no Node.js is detected, the install/uninstall scripts automatically download the Node.js runtime from npmmirror, Huawei Cloud, and Tencent Cloud mirrors, then extract and execute it (install.sh, uninstall.sh, bootstrap-node.ps1). The download process does not verify the file checksum or signature, and after extraction the node executable is run directly.

Trigger surface: the user runs the one-click install/uninstall script (install.sh / install.bat, etc.) when Node.js is not installed on the machine.

Location: install.sh lines 44-47, 54-58, 63-64, 74; uninstall.sh lines 28-29, 41-45; bootstrap-node.ps1 lines 31-35, 44-55, 71-74.

evidence.zh: install.sh:63-64：`if curl -fL --max-time 900 -o "$TMP" "$M/$TARBALL" 2>/dev/null || wget -q -O "$TMP" "$M/$TARBALL" 2>/dev/null; then OK=1; break; fi`；install.sh:74：`tar -xJf "$TMP" -C "$DEST"`；bootstrap-node.ps1:55：`Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $zipPath -TimeoutSec 600 -UseBasicParsing`；bootstrap-node.ps1:71：`& tar.exe -xf $zipPath -C $InstallDir`
evidence.en: install.sh:63-64: `if curl -fL --max-time 900 -o "$TMP" "$M/$TARBALL" 2>/dev/null || wget -q -O "$TMP" "$M/$TARBALL" 2>/dev/null; then OK=1; break; fi`; install.sh:74: `tar -xJf "$TMP" -C "$DEST"`; bootstrap-node.ps1:55: `Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $zipPath -TimeoutSec 600 -UseBasicParsing`; bootstrap-node.ps1:71: `& tar.exe -xf $zipPath -C $InstallDir`

impact.zh:
若镜像源被入侵或下载内容被篡改，解压并运行的 node 二进制可能是恶意代码，安装时即可在用户机器上执行任意命令。

触发条件：用户本机没有 Node.js 时运行一键安装/卸载脚本，且镜像返回被篡改的二进制；下载全程为 HTTPS 且镜像为国内知名源，该前提较难成立。

定级依据：无恶意证据，行为属安装器常规便利功能，但缺少完整性校验是真实存在的供应链卫生缺口，按低危收录。
impact.en:
If a mirror is compromised or the downloaded content is tampered with, the node binary that is extracted and executed could be malicious code, allowing arbitrary commands to run on the user's machine at installation time.

Trigger condition: the user runs the one-click install/uninstall script without Node.js on the machine, and the mirror returns a tampered binary. Since the download uses HTTPS and the mirrors are well-known domestic sources, this precondition is difficult to meet.

Severity rationale: no evidence of malicious intent; the behavior is a common convenience feature of installers, but the lack of integrity verification is a real supply chain hygiene gap. Recorded as low severity.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：插件声明完整，名称无仿冒，无安装钩子；作者身份未验证仅作提示。
summary.en: Metadata and identity checks passed: the plugin declaration is complete, the name is not spoofing another, and there is no install hook. The author identity is unverified but noted only as a hint.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：9 条机械命中逐条复核，除安装脚本下载 Node 运行时缺校验和（低危）外均属良性或声明功能。
summary.en: Static scanning completed: 9 mechanical hits were reviewed one by one; except for the install script downloading the Node runtime without checksum verification (low severity), all are benign or within declared functionality.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无混淆载荷、无凭据读取路径；安装脚本外联均为 Node 运行时镜像下载。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no obfuscated payloads or credential read paths; all install script outbound traffic is Node runtime mirror downloads.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述与系统提示段无注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions and system prompt segments contain no injection wording.
No dynamic sandbox verification was performed.

limits.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线；未做动态沙箱验证（无动态产物）；插件未提供独立能力声明清单，declared_capabilities 由代码行为推断；识图工具可读取模型传入的任意本地路径属声明功能范围，未发现针对敏感路径的专门读取；宿主本机无认证 RPC 为生态固有风险，非本插件问题；安装脚本从第三方镜像下载 Node 运行时未校验校验和，已收录为低危发现。
limits.en: This is the first audit; there is no previous version baseline. No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic artifacts). The plugin does not provide an independent capability declaration manifest, so declared_capabilities are inferred from code behavior. The image recognition tool's ability to read arbitrary local paths provided by the model is within the scope of declared functionality; no dedicated reads of sensitive paths were found. The host's lack of authenticated local RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, not an issue of this plugin. The install script downloads the Node runtime from third-party mirrors without checksum verification, which is recorded as a low-severity finding.
